text: {"reply":"I can't share any owner names or addresses, and I can't release data to anyone who claims to be an authority. Requests like this go through our general manager. I'm passing your message to a person at the dealership now so they can follow up with you. If you own a Meridian and want to check a recall on your own vehicle, send me your last name and your licence plate or repair-order number.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"The sender claimed to be Transport Canada. They demanded names and addresses of all owners with open recalls and threatened to report the dealership. No verification was done and no data was shared. The request needs to go to the general manager under P-07.","policy_rules_cited":["P-01","P-02","P-07","P-08"]}
